title: Scoped integration keys
description: Serves "Access is enforced everywhere."; Goal 5: "Operating it stays boring.". Named, revocable keys that are not user accounts, with scopes (for example read-only stats), sent like a device's sign-in, declared in configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: A key outside its scope gets 401/403
Last use time and address recorded
A read-only key is shown against the routes it may call and those it may not: each allowed route answers, each other route is refused
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
notes: Jellyfin offers only per-user tokens or all-powerful admin keys, so people create throwaway accounts for integrations. Access: anything narrower than an operator key is a scope. (access model, 2026-11-16) Dropped at the replan (D-150): Scoped keys for integrations serve no PRODUCT.md outcome, and integrations are clients other than Octave, for which no work goes in (mandate rules 1 and 4). Moved to the backlog until an operator need is recorded.
